dashboard.capacity.col.429s.desc: Column header. '429' is an HTTP status and must survive verbatim.

dashboard.capacity.col.current_rate.desc: Column header. The key's instantaneous rate against its configured limit.

dashboard.capacity.empty.no_capacity_dat.en: No capacity data for this time range

dashboard.capacity.history.no_data.few.desc: CLDR plural category 'few' of the note about intervals whose configured capacity is unknown. {n} is the count and must stay a placeholder. English distinguishes only 'one' and 'other', so this form repeats the English of 'other' — do not assume the categories are identical in your language.

dashboard.capacity.history.no_data.many.desc: CLDR plural category 'many' of the note about intervals whose configured capacity is unknown. {n} is the count and must stay a placeholder. English distinguishes only 'one' and 'other', so this form repeats the English of 'other' — do not assume the categories are identical in your language.

dashboard.capacity.history.no_data.one.desc: CLDR plural category 'one' of the note about intervals whose configured capacity is unknown. {n} is the count and must stay a placeholder. This is the singular English uses for exactly 1.

dashboard.capacity.history.no_data.other.desc: CLDR plural category 'other' of the note about intervals whose configured capacity is unknown. {n} is the count and must stay a placeholder. English uses this form for every count except 1, including 0.

dashboard.capacity.history.no_data.two.desc: CLDR plural category 'two' of the note about intervals whose configured capacity is unknown. {n} is the count and must stay a placeholder. English distinguishes only 'one' and 'other', so this form repeats the English of 'other' — do not assume the categories are identical in your language.

dashboard.capacity.history.no_data.zero.desc: CLDR plural category 'zero' of the note about intervals whose configured capacity is unknown. {n} is the count and must stay a placeholder. English distinguishes only 'one' and 'other', so this form repeats the English of 'other' — do not assume the categories are identical in your language.

dashboard.capacity.history.shortfall.desc: Unit label under the Capacity history figure: the largest amount by which demand exceeded the capacity configured at the time. 'rpm' is a unit and must survive verbatim; '·' is a separator.

dashboard.capacity.history.utilization.en: avg {avg} · peak {peak} of capacity at the time
dashboard.capacity.history.utilization.desc: Footer under the Capacity history figure. {avg} and {peak} are already-formatted percentages. 'at the time' means against the capacity configured then, not today's. Lowercase note, not a heading.

dashboard.capacity.note.current_vs_capac.desc: Note beside the Saturation heading, explaining what the percentage divides: the pool's current request rate over its total configured capacity. Lowercase note, not a heading.

dashboard.capacity.note.enabled_keys.few.desc: CLDR plural category 'few' of the sub-label under the saturation bar. {n} is the count of enabled upstream NIM API keys and must stay a placeholder. English distinguishes only 'one' and 'other', so this form repeats the English of 'other' — do not assume the categories are identical in your language.

dashboard.capacity.note.enabled_keys.man.desc: CLDR plural category 'many' of the sub-label under the saturation bar. {n} is the count of enabled upstream NIM API keys and must stay a placeholder. English distinguishes only 'one' and 'other', so this form repeats the English of 'other' — do not assume the categories are identical in your language.

dashboard.capacity.note.enabled_keys.one.desc: CLDR plural category 'one' of the sub-label under the saturation bar. {n} is the count of enabled upstream NIM API keys and must stay a placeholder. This is the singular English uses for exactly 1.

dashboard.capacity.note.enabled_keys.oth.desc: CLDR plural category 'other' of the sub-label under the saturation bar. {n} is the count of enabled upstream NIM API keys and must stay a placeholder. English uses this form for every count except 1, including 0.

dashboard.capacity.note.enabled_keys.two.desc: CLDR plural category 'two' of the sub-label under the saturation bar. {n} is the count of enabled upstream NIM API keys and must stay a placeholder. English distinguishes only 'one' and 'other', so this form repeats the English of 'other' — do not assume the categories are identical in your language.

dashboard.capacity.note.enabled_keys.zer.desc: CLDR plural category 'zero' of the sub-label under the saturation bar. {n} is the count of enabled upstream NIM API keys and must stay a placeholder. English distinguishes only 'one' and 'other', so this form repeats the English of 'other' — do not assume the categories are identical in your language.

dashboard.capacity.note.rpm_available.desc: Follows a number in the saturation footer: how much of the pool's per-minute capacity is still unused. 'rpm' is a unit and must survive verbatim; only 'available' is translated.

dashboard.clients.maxtok.note.desc: max_tokens is an API parameter name and must survive verbatim.

dashboard.clients.sampling.note.desc: The model sampling parameter, not a physical temperature.

dashboard.common.col.client.desc: Table column header. The calling agent or tool, not an end user.

dashboard.common.col.count.desc: Table column header. Number of requests with this outcome.

dashboard.common.col.key.desc: Table column header. An upstream NIM API key. Not a keyboard key or a map key.

dashboard.common.col.model.desc: Table column header. The model identifier for the row.

dashboard.common.col.reason.desc: Table column header. Why a request did not return 200.

dashboard.common.col.requests.desc: Table column header. Count of requests in the selected time range.

dashboard.common.col.share.desc: Table column header. This row's percentage of the total. Noun, never the verb.

dashboard.common.col.streaming.desc: Share of this client's requests that used streaming responses.

dashboard.common.empty.history_unavailab.en: History unavailable for selected time range
dashboard.common.empty.history_unavailab.desc: Range status when history exists globally but no usable observation covers the selected interval.

dashboard.common.empty.no_data_in_range.en: No data in selected time range

dashboard.common.kpi.delta_tooltip.en: second half of this time range vs the first

dashboard.common.kpi.success_rate.desc: KPI label. Share of requests that returned 200.

dashboard.common.note.selected_time_rang.desc: Sub-label under a KPI number: the figure covers the time range currently selected in the topbar, not all history.

dashboard.common.row.active_now.desc: Requests in flight at this instant, not a windowed aggregate.

dashboard.common.row.error_rate.desc: Live-panel label beside Active now and Queued: the share of requests in the selected time range that did not return 2xx. Noun phrase, not an imperative.

dashboard.common.status.client_disconnec.desc: Non-success reason: the calling client closed the connection before the response finished.

dashboard.common.status.client_error_4xx.desc: Outcome band for 4xx statuses other than 429. '4xx' is an HTTP status class and must survive verbatim.

dashboard.common.status.disconnect.desc: Outcome band: the client went away before the response finished. Noun, not the imperative verb.

dashboard.common.status.rate_limited.desc: Outcome band: requests the upstream rejected with 429. Past participle describing the requests.

dashboard.common.status.stream_error.desc: Non-success reason: the upstream stream failed mid-response.

dashboard.common.status.stream_stalled.desc: Non-success reason: the upstream stopped emitting tokens and the request was abandoned.

dashboard.common.status.success.desc: Outcome band and stacked-chart series: requests that returned a 2xx status. Noun.

dashboard.common.status.timeout_stall.desc: Outcome band grouping upstream timeouts (504) with stalled streams. Two nouns joined by a slash.

dashboard.common.tag.now.desc: Badge on a card heading: this figure is the live instant, not an aggregate over the selected time range. Adverb of time.

dashboard.models.cards.note.en: top 4 by tokens out · full list in the table below
dashboard.models.cards.note.desc: Note above the leading-model cards. 'top 4' is a count of cards shown.

dashboard.models.col.avg_tps.desc: Column header. 'tok/s' is a unit and must survive verbatim.

dashboard.models.col.avg_ttft.desc: Column header. 'TTFT' is an abbreviation and must survive verbatim.

dashboard.models.count_with_sort.few.en: {n} models · click a column to sort

dashboard.models.count_with_sort.many.en: {n} models · click a column to sort

dashboard.models.count_with_sort.one.en: {n} model · click a column to sort

dashboard.models.count_with_sort.other.en: {n} models · click a column to sort

dashboard.models.count_with_sort.two.en: {n} models · click a column to sort

dashboard.models.count_with_sort.zero.en: {n} models · click a column to sort

dashboard.models.finish.completed.desc: Finish reason. The response ended normally.

dashboard.models.finish.filtered.desc: Finish reason. Stopped by the upstream content filter.

dashboard.models.finish.other.desc: Finish reason matched by no known value.

dashboard.models.scorecard.note.en: top models head to head · best in each column highlighted

dashboard.nav.live.disconnected.desc: Live-tail control: the browser lost contact with the proxy.

dashboard.nav.live.following.desc: Live-tail control: the range follows the present.

dashboard.nav.live.frozen.desc: Live-tail control: the range is pinned to fixed bounds.

dashboard.nav.live.tooltip.en: Click to freeze/resume the selected time range

dashboard.nav.tab.models.desc: Navigation tab. Plural noun: the per-LLM-model section.

dashboard.overview.perf.higher_is_better.desc: Note beside a throughput distribution: larger numbers are better. Lowercase, sits under the card heading.

dashboard.overview.perf.lower_is_better.desc: Note beside a latency distribution: smaller numbers are better. Lowercase, sits under the card heading.

dashboard.overview.performance.note.en: median & p95 across the time range

dashboard.overview.ring.capacity_used.desc: Ring-gauge label. Share of the key pool's configured requests-per-minute currently in use.

dashboard.reliability.col.first_token.desc: Latency segment: time to the first token. Do not expand to the TTFT acronym.

dashboard.reliability.col.generation.desc: Latency segment: token generation after the first token.

dashboard.reliability.empty.no_errors.en: No errors in this time range

dashboard.reliability.hero.budget_used.desc: Right-hand side of the error-budget row: how much of the budget is consumed. {pct} is an already-formatted percentage.

dashboard.reliability.hero.error_budget.desc: SLO error budget: how much of the allowed unavailability has already been consumed. Lowercase on purpose — it sits inline above the budget bar, not as a heading.

dashboard.reliability.pressure.series.desc: Chart series name: upstream worker-capacity errors per minute.

dashboard.reliability.row.buffered.desc: Opposite of streaming: the whole response returned at once.

dashboard.reliability.row.dropped_503.desc: '503' is an HTTP status and must survive verbatim.

dashboard.reliability.row.tool_choice.desc: The API parameter rendered as a label.

dashboard.reliability.slo.met.desc: Under the availability figure when the target was achieved. 'SLO' is an abbreviation and must survive verbatim; {target} is the target percentage.

dashboard.reliability.slo.missed.desc: Under the availability figure when the target was not achieved. 'SLO' must survive verbatim; {target} is the target percentage.

dashboard.reliability.slo.no_traffic.desc: Under the availability figure when the time range contains no requests the SLO counts. 'SLO' must survive verbatim; {target} is the target percentage.

dashboard.topbar.custom.apply.desc: Button, imperative verb. Applies the entered range.

dashboard.topbar.custom.from.desc: Accessible name for the start of a custom dashboard time range.

dashboard.topbar.custom.to.desc: Separator between the from and to datetime inputs. Preposition, not a verb.

dashboard.topbar.custom.to_label.desc: Accessible name for the end of a custom dashboard time range.

dashboard.topbar.range.custom.desc: Toggle button. Opens the from/to picker. Adjective used as a label.

dashboard.topbar.range.default.desc: Toggle button. 'Default' is an adjective qualifying the preset time range; 30d is its length.

dashboard.topbar.range.p1h.desc: Short duration abbreviation on a time-range pill.

dashboard.topbar.range.p24h.desc: Short duration abbreviation on a time-range pill.

dashboard.topbar.range.p30d.desc: Short duration abbreviation on a time-range pill.

dashboard.topbar.range.p6h.desc: Short duration abbreviation on a time-range pill.

dashboard.topbar.range.p7d.desc: Short duration abbreviation on a time-range pill.

dashboard.topbar.scope.partial_history.desc: Range status for incomplete history; variables are the effective observed bounds, not the requested bounds.

login.document.title.desc: Browser tab title for the sign-in page.

login.error.invalid_credentials.desc: Generic authentication failure; never disclose which credential was wrong.

settings.account.note.en: Changing your password signs out your other sessions.

settings.client_key.note.en: These bearer tokens authenticate your clients.

settings.dialog.delete_user.en: Delete {username}? Their NIM API keys leave the pool and their client API keys are revoked.

settings.dialog.remove_key.en: Remove NIM API key nvapi-••••{last4} from the pool? In-flight requests finish, but its rate-limit window is lost.

settings.dialog.revoke_client_key.en: Revoke client API key "{name}"? Clients using it stop working immediately.

settings.error.load.en: Could not load Settings. Reload the page and sign in again.

settings.key.empty.en: No NIM API keys yet — add one below

settings.key.guarded.en: Protected: the superuser must keep at least one enabled NIM API key. Add or enable another before removing this one.

settings.key.notice.admin.en: Keys you add are assigned to your account and join the shared pool. Changes take effect immediately. Disabling a key preserves its rate-limit state.

settings.key.notice.mine.en: Keys you add are assigned to your account and join the shared pool. Only you and admins can see that they exist. Changes take effect immediately. Disabling a key preserves its rate-limit state.

settings.key.placeholder.en: Paste a new NIM API key (nvapi-…)

settings.key.rpm.desc: Accessible name for a NIM API key rate-limit input.

settings.mode.help.en: Controls /v1 client calls only. In API key required mode, clients use a bearer token. Open (no authentication) allows anyone who can reach /v1. Use only on trusted networks.
settings.mode.help.desc: Full API access-mode explanation. This is deliberately one plain catalog sentence; the former bold literals are not parsed or reassembled at runtime.

settings.mode.keyed_note.en: Clients authenticate with a client API key.

settings.mode.no_client_keys.en: Requiring an API key with no client API keys locks every client out. Generate one under Access & keys.

settings.mode.open_note.en: Anyone who can reach /v1 can use the pool.

settings.secret.ready.en: Client API key “{name}” is ready. Copy it now.

settings.server.base_url.desc: Accessible name for the configurable upstream base URL.

settings.server.base_url_note.en: Saving changes the upstream base URL and clears the model catalog cache.

settings.server.history.bytes.few.desc: CLDR plural category 'few' for the history data-file size. {bytes} is already locale-formatted; English repeats the other form.

settings.server.history.bytes.many.desc: CLDR plural category 'many' for the history data-file size. {bytes} is already locale-formatted; English repeats the other form.

settings.server.history.bytes.one.desc: CLDR plural category 'one' for the history data-file size. {bytes} is already locale-formatted.

settings.server.history.bytes.other.desc: CLDR plural category 'other' for the history data-file size. {bytes} is already locale-formatted.

settings.server.history.bytes.two.desc: CLDR plural category 'two' for the history data-file size. {bytes} is already locale-formatted; English repeats the other form.

settings.server.history.bytes.zero.desc: CLDR plural category 'zero' for the history data-file size. {bytes} is already locale-formatted; English repeats the other form.

settings.server.history.persistence_degr.en: History persistence is degraded. Restart the proxy to retry canonical storage.

settings.server.model_concurrency.desc: Accessible name for a per-model governor override limit.

settings.server.model_limits_help.en: Limits concurrent requests per model when NIM reports worker exhaustion. Limits adjust automatically; add an override only for a known concurrency limit.

settings.server.strict_note.en: Rejects parameters the upstream does not accept.

settings.users.client_key_count.few.desc: CLDR plural category 'few' for the user's client API key count. {n} is already locale-formatted; English repeats the other form.

settings.users.client_key_count.many.desc: CLDR plural category 'many' for the user's client API key count. {n} is already locale-formatted; English repeats the other form.

settings.users.client_key_count.one.desc: CLDR plural category 'one' for the user's client API key count. {n} is already locale-formatted.

settings.users.client_key_count.other.desc: CLDR plural category 'other' for the user's client API key count. {n} is already locale-formatted.

settings.users.client_key_count.two.desc: CLDR plural category 'two' for the user's client API key count. {n} is already locale-formatted; English repeats the other form.

settings.users.client_key_count.zero.desc: CLDR plural category 'zero' for the user's client API key count. {n} is already locale-formatted; English repeats the other form.

settings.users.nim_key_count.few.desc: CLDR plural category 'few' for the user's NIM API key count. {n} is already locale-formatted; English repeats the other form.

settings.users.nim_key_count.many.desc: CLDR plural category 'many' for the user's NIM API key count. {n} is already locale-formatted; English repeats the other form.

settings.users.nim_key_count.one.desc: CLDR plural category 'one' for the user's NIM API key count. {n} is already locale-formatted.

settings.users.nim_key_count.other.desc: CLDR plural category 'other' for the user's NIM API key count. {n} is already locale-formatted.

settings.users.nim_key_count.two.desc: CLDR plural category 'two' for the user's NIM API key count. {n} is already locale-formatted; English repeats the other form.

settings.users.nim_key_count.zero.desc: CLDR plural category 'zero' for the user's NIM API key count. {n} is already locale-formatted; English repeats the other form.

settings.users.note.en: Deleting a user removes their NIM API keys from the pool and revokes their client API keys.

settings.users.superuser_note.en: The superuser changes its own password in Account settings.

settings.validation.client_key_name.en: Enter a client API key name, for example laptop-cli.

settings.validation.governor.en: Enter a model ID and a concurrency limit of at least 1.

settings.validation.history_default.en: Default time range must be at least 1 day.

settings.validation.history_retention.en: History retention must be 0 or more days.

settings.validation.initial_password.en: Initial password must be at least 10 characters.

settings.validation.limits.en: Every limit needs a whole number ≥ 0.

settings.validation.models_added.few.en: ✓ {n} models found. Adding NIM API key…
settings.validation.models_added.few.desc: CLDR plural category 'few' for successful NIM API key validation. {n} is the number of returned models and is already locale-formatted; English repeats the other form.

settings.validation.models_added.many.en: ✓ {n} models found. Adding NIM API key…
settings.validation.models_added.many.desc: CLDR plural category 'many' for successful NIM API key validation. {n} is the number of returned models and is already locale-formatted; English repeats the other form.

settings.validation.models_added.one.en: ✓ {n} model found. Adding NIM API key…
settings.validation.models_added.one.desc: CLDR plural category 'one' for successful NIM API key validation. {n} is the number of returned models and is already locale-formatted.

settings.validation.models_added.other.en: ✓ {n} models found. Adding NIM API key…
settings.validation.models_added.other.desc: CLDR plural category 'other' for successful NIM API key validation. {n} is the number of returned models and is already locale-formatted.

settings.validation.models_added.two.en: ✓ {n} models found. Adding NIM API key…
settings.validation.models_added.two.desc: CLDR plural category 'two' for successful NIM API key validation. {n} is the number of returned models and is already locale-formatted; English repeats the other form.

settings.validation.models_added.zero.en: ✓ {n} models found. Adding NIM API key…
settings.validation.models_added.zero.desc: CLDR plural category 'zero' for successful NIM API key validation. {n} is the number of returned models and is already locale-formatted; English repeats the other form.

settings.validation.new_password.en: New password must be at least 10 characters.

settings.validation.nim_key_required.en: Paste a NIM API key first.

settings.validation.password.en: Password must be at least 10 characters.

settings.validation.password_updated.en: Password updated. Other sessions were signed out.

settings.validation.slo.en: SLO target must be greater than 0 and at most 100.

setup.document.title.desc: Browser tab title. 'NIM Proxy' is the product name and stays.

setup.header.subtitle.en: Complete setup: create the superuser account and add at least one NIM API key.

setup.header.title.desc: Follows the untranslated NIM PROXY wordmark.

setup.step1.error.password_length.en: Password must be at least 10 characters.
setup.step1.error.password_length.desc: Validation error under the account form. 10 is the enforced minimum length.

setup.step1.error.username_charset.desc: Validation error under the account form. The character set and the 1-32 range are enforced by the server and must survive verbatim.

setup.step1.hint.en: The superuser account cannot be deleted.
setup.step1.hint.desc: The one durable restriction this hint communicates.

setup.step1.username.placeholder.desc: Input placeholder. 'e.g.' needs the locale's own abbreviation; 'admin' is a suggested value.

setup.step2.base_url.desc: Accessible name for the optional setup upstream URL input.

setup.step2.error.key_duplicate.desc: Validation error: the same NIM key is already in the list.

setup.step2.error.key_required.en: Paste a NIM API key first.
setup.step2.error.key_required.desc: Validation error: the key field is empty. 'NIM' is the vendor product name and stays.

setup.step2.error.validation_failed.desc: The upstream rejected the key. {error} is the upstream's own error text or an HTTP status code, inserted verbatim and never translated.

setup.step2.error.validation_request.desc: The browser could not reach the proxy to validate the key. {error} is the browser's error text, inserted verbatim and never translated.

setup.step2.hint.en: NIM API keys are shared across clients. The default rate limit is 40 requests/min per key.
setup.step2.hint.desc: Explains pool sharing and the default per-key rate limit.

setup.step2.key_label.desc: Accessible name for the setup NIM API key input.

setup.step2.key_meta.desc: Meta line on an added key: how many models the key reached, then its per-minute limit. 'rpm' is a unit and must survive verbatim.

setup.step2.rpm_label.desc: Accessible name for the setup NIM API key rate-limit input.

setup.step2.validating.desc: Button label while a key is probed upstream.

setup.step3.api_access_keyed.en: API key required · first client key "default"
setup.step3.api_access_keyed.desc: Review line, shown when the wizard will mint a client key. "default" is the key's literal name and must survive verbatim, quotes included.

setup.step3.api_access_open.en: API key required · no client keys configured
setup.step3.api_access_open.desc: Review line when keyed mode has no client keys.

setup.step3.error.failed.desc: The proxy rejected the setup request. {status} is the HTTP status code, a number inserted verbatim.

setup.step3.error.request.desc: The browser could not reach the proxy to submit setup. {error} is the browser's error text, inserted verbatim and never translated.

setup.step3.mintkey.en: Create the first client API key ({key}) for immediate access to {endpoint}
setup.step3.mintkey.desc: Checkbox label. {key} and {endpoint} are fixed machine values.

setup.step3.mintwarn.en: Without a client API key, {b}all{/b} /v1 requests are rejected. Create one in Settings → Access & keys, or change API authentication to Open (no authentication).
setup.step3.mintwarn.desc: {b}...{/b} emphasizes that every /v1 request is rejected until the operator creates a client key or explicitly opens API authentication.

setup.step3.review.api_access.desc: Review-panel row label. Whether the proxy's own /v1 endpoint will require a client API key.

setup.step3.review.keys.desc: Review-panel row label: the upstream NIM API keys added in step 2. 'NIM' is the vendor product name and stays.

setup.step3.review.keys_value.desc: Review-panel value for the NIM keys row: how many keys validated, then the pool's combined per-minute limit. 'rpm' is a unit and must survive verbatim.

setup.step3.review.superuser.desc: Review-panel row label. The role of the account being created; the proxy persists this same role name.

setup.step3.review.upstream.desc: Review-panel row label. The upstream base URL requests are forwarded to; the value beside it is a URL.

setup.step4.copied.desc: Button label after a successful clipboard copy. Past tense.

setup.step4.copy.desc: Button, imperative verb. Copies the adjacent value to the clipboard.

setup.step4.intro.en: Setup complete. Configure your client with the proxy URL and API key below. The API key is shown {b}only once{/b}; only its digest is stored.

setup.step4.opendash.desc: Button, imperative verb phrase. 'Open' is the verb, not the API-mode adjective.

setup.step4.select_copy.desc: Button label when the clipboard API is unavailable and the user must copy manually.
